subject: planner: flaky test TestIssue25729 (#64774)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its parent. The only planner behavior change is in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_ver2.go` (`getPlanCostVer24PhysicalIndexScan`): it adds a tiny deterministic tie-breaker cost based on `Index.ID%100 / 1e6` via new helper `pkg/planner/util/costusage/cost_misc.go:AddCostWithoutTrace`, intended to break equal-cost index ties and stabilize plan selection. This should not affect SQL correctness/transaction/privilege semantics (it only perturbs optimizer cost ordering in exact/near ties); golden cost outputs were updated accordingly.
